verdict.rationale: Solo 2 is a hardware FIDO2/passkey security key, and user-defined, event-triggered automation rules are outside what this kind of product does, so the axis does not apply. Nothing in the evidence shows such a capability. Custom firmware flashing on the Hacker edition is only a developer building block, not a rules feature, so it does not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
